d: Capital of the Annunaki Empire. Nibiru orbits Sol at ~290 AU. The Firmament conceals the system from Earth and the Moon. Earth’s ~8.2 billion humans were unaware until the May 25, 2028 broadcast exposed alien control.
280-million-year-old civilisation. Founders of the Galactic Federation. Zero military vessels — their mining ships could dismantle a fleet. 36.7 ly from Sol.
Officially Federation-aligned but practically fractured. Shadow civil cold war between loyalists and Empire collaborators. 8.6 ly from Sol.
Federation warrior culture. ~38 million inhabitants across five worlds (including Erra), plus ~600 million in habitats and outposts. Gate-connected sanctuary. 444 ly from Sol.
28 billion Reptilians. 800+ warships. The Empire’s enforcement arm. 303 ly from Sol.
62-million-year-old Lyran derelict infrastructure. Annunaki-claimed by right of conquest. 25 ly from Sol.
Loyalist Nebu faction. Dissident Wanderers cooperate with Federation. 39.3 ly from Sol.
Resource extraction and military staging. 10.5 ly from Sol.
Independent Cethari mercantile republic on Meranthe. No confirmed Federation membership. Sublight only; interested in trade. 11.9 ly from Sol.
Nommo proximi: aquatic diaspora from Sirius on Proxima b. Isolationist, with Sirian kinship but no confirmed Federation membership. FTL reported; method unknown. 4.37 ly from Sol.
Independent, isolationist Capellans (Tall Whites), an early Lyran divergent branch. No established Imperial affiliation. Homeworld designation undisclosed. ~43 ly from Sol.
Manthari hive civilisation on Thurakh. ~40 billion, of whom ~8–12 million are sapient. Grey-allied biological consultants; not established as Annunaki-controlled. 11.4 ly from Sol.
Seven rocky worlds; potentially habitable planets. Settlement and faction occupancy remain open questions in lore bible v7. 40.7 ly from Sol.
Probable automated Annunaki monitoring/relay station; specific installation not confirmed. General Imperial monitoring is assumed near Sol. 5.96 ly from Sol.
Specific occupancy unknown. Could conceal Imperial monitoring, covert Federation installations, or both. 7.9 ly from Sol.
Dark binary brown dwarfs. Potential covert staging location, including a possible Federation presence; no confirmed occupant. 6.5 ly from Sol.
Quiet red dwarf with a potentially habitable rocky planet. Possible Imperial labour colony or automated infrastructure; actual occupancy unconfirmed. 11 ly from Sol.
